Name: Love Letters - Chinese Translation
Author: 124584DXZA
Description:
这个汉化mod是在作者Speremint的mod“love letter”的基础上汉化制作的。很感谢原作者的付出！
我的汉化mod的使用方法：
1。请下载原作者的“love letter”mod，并将它安装至你的mod文件夹。下载地址：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2388?tab=files]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2388?tab=files[/url] 。
2.下载我的汉化包。
3.解压我的汉化包，将我的汉化包拖进你的“love letter”mod中选择替换。
有任何问题请反应！谢谢

This Chinese - translated mod is developed based on the "Love Letter" mod created by the author Speremint. We're really grateful for the original author's dedication!Here's how to use my Chinese - translated mod:1.Download the original author's "Love Letter" mod and install it in your mod folder. Download link: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2388?tab=files]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2388?tab=files[/url]2.Download my Chinese - translation package.3.Extract the Chinese - translation package and drag it into your "Love Letter" mod, then choose to replace the relevant files.Please report any issues you encounter! Thank you.
